english.title: Operate / use a radio / thing likely to affect communication / navigation at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated or used

(A)_[a radio transmitter]_
(B)_[a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..), capable of radiating electrical interference]_

in such a way as to adversely affect or be likely to adversely affect the operation of a

(C)_[communications]_
(D)_[navigation]_

system at Southampton Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(7) and 2(2) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
